author: bit-man
html:
In case java located in other location than /use/bin or use sdkman for version management just use the next shebang

#!/usr/bin/env -S java –source 21

Enjoy!

author: Someone
html:
When editing the file in your favorite IDE it will complain about the bad syntax of line one, as this is not valid java code.

Therefore you can replace line one with “///usr/bin/env java $0 $@ –source 21; exit $?;” to achieve the same.

This trick is used by JBang and similar projects
